basic_details.job_title: ICMR NIRRCH Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women’s Health (ICMR NIRRCH) has announced recruitment for 1 vacancy for the Project Research Scientist–I (Non-Medical) post on a project-based and purely temporary basis in Mumbai. The tenure is for one year with further extension based on performance up to a total project tenure of 3 years. The post requires a Post Graduate Degree in Biological Sciences (Immunology/Life Sciences / Biotechnology or similar) with three years post-qualification experience in a research laboratory or a Ph.D. (Thesis submitted) in Biological Sciences, carrying a pay of Rs.

important_dates.interview_date: To be communicated to shortlisted candidates later

how_to_apply: Visit the online application portal at the official link: https://application.nirrch.res.in/login.php
Select the post 'Project Research Scientist-I (NM)-TROP2' to apply for the said requirement.
Submit your application online on or before 21st October, 2026.
In case of any issue while submitting the application through the online mode, send an email to [email protected] or [email protected]

content_sections.heading: ICMR NIRRCH Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) at a Glance

rows.details: ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women’s Health (ICMR-NIRRCH)
Project Study funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR)
Preclinical study evaluating active immunotherapeutic potential of Trop2 extracellular domain using mouse models of cancer
One Year (Further extension based on performance; Total Project Tenure = 3 Years)
35 Years (Age relaxation as per Government of India norms would be applicable)
ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women’s Health, J M Street, Parel, Mumbai 400012, Maharashtra

rows.essential_qualification: Post Graduate Degree in Biological Sciences (Immunology/Life Sciences / Biotechnology or similar) with three years post-qualification experience in a research laboratory Or Ph.D. (Thesis submitted) in Biological Sciences
rows.desirable: Ph.D. in Life Sciences/ Biotechnology/ Molecular Biology/ immunology or a related discipline; Experience in flow cytometry and cell culture technique; Experience in recombinant protein production handling rodents; Knowledge of statistical analysis

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated salary for the Project Research Scientist–I (Non-Medical) post is Rs. 72,800/- per month, which includes Rs. 56,000/- plus 30% HRA. The position is purely temporary for a duration of one year, with further extension based on performance, up to a total project tenure of 3 years.

content_sections.heading: ICMR NIRRCH Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be responsible for the following duties under the project: Planning and performing the experiments Training the junior staff Data analysis and report writing Maintaining lab records

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICMR NIRRCH Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical)
content_sections.text: Visit the online application portal at the official link: https://application.nirrch.res.in/login.php Select the post 'Project Research Scientist-I (NM)-TROP2' to apply for the said requirement. Submit your application online on or before 21st October, 2026. In case of any issue while submitting the application through the online mode, send an email to [email protected] or [email protected]

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: All applications will be screened, and only shortlisted candidates will be invited for physical interaction or an online interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed regarding the details of the interview later. Only candidates meeting eligible qualifications should apply.

rows.date: To be communicated to shortlisted candidates later

faq.question: Q1. What is the name of the post announced in this recruitment notification?
faq.answer: The notification announces 1 vacancy for the Project Research Scientist–I (Non-Medical) post under the ICMR-funded project.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There is exactly 1 vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist–I (Non-Medical) post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application is 21st October, 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for the Project Research Scientist-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree in Biological Sciences (Immunology/Life Sciences / Biotechnology or similar) with three years post-qualification experience in a research laboratory, or a Ph.D. (Thesis submitted) in Biological Sciences.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years, with age relaxation applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the consolidated salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The consolidated salary is Rs. 72,800/- per month, which includes Rs. 56,000/- plus 30% HRA.

faq.question: Q7. Is the job permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: The position is purely temporary on a project basis for an initial duration of one year, with further extension based on performance up to a total project tenure of 3 years.

faq.question: Q8. What are the desirable qualifications for this post?
faq.answer: Desirable qualifications include a Ph.D. in Life Sciences/Biotechnology/Molecular Biology/Immunology or a related discipline, experience in flow cytometry and cell culture technique, experience in recombinant protein production handling rodents, and knowledge of statistical analysis.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for the position?
faq.answer: All applications will be screened, and only shortlisted candidates will be invited for a physical interaction or an online interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official link to submit the online application?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the official portal at https://application.nirrch.res.in/login.php by selecting the post 'Project Research Scientist-I (NM)-TROP2'.
